day_shape: 50 items: France drafts UN resolution on Strait of Hormuz mission, CENTCOM says US blockade has redirected 97 commercial vessels, Rubio reports 'some progress' in Iran talks, IDF strikes in southern Lebanon, fresh OFAC SDN designation, heavy regime messaging on Raisi's martyrdom anniversary.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz blockade and counter-claims
threads.summary: France's foreign ministry said it has drafted a UN resolution to establish an international mission to restore movement in the Strait of Hormuz, while CENTCOM said US forces have redirected 97 commercial vessels and disabled four since the blockade began. Defa Press claimed the IRGC Navy coordinated passage of 35 vessels through the strait in the past 24 hours; Times of Israel reported Iran is moving to broaden control over Hormuz.

threads.label: US-Iran talks and Pakistani mediation
threads.summary: Rubio told reporters after a NATO meeting the US has seen some progress in talks with Iran but more work is needed, while Jerusalem Post reported Pakistani diplomats are holding another round of talks with Iran's foreign minister. Defa Press said Pakistan's Army Commander Asim Munir travelled to Tehran, and an Iranian official denied any draft US-Iran agreement exists.

threads.label: IDF operations in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF Arabic spokesperson issued an evacuation alert to residents of Borj Rahal village demanding withdrawal of at least 1,000 metres, and posted footage of a strike said to have eliminated a Hezbollah cell hiding in civilian homes. Defa Press claimed Hezbollah attacks caused explosions and fires in the al-Jalil area and that drones have disrupted 80 per cent of Israeli army operations in southern Lebanon.

threads.label: War costs and US military strain
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported US Navy Acting Secretary Hung Cao told a congressional hearing the US paused a $14 billion arms package for Taiwan due to military constraints related to the Iran war. IRIB cited a Washington Post account of a Pentagon assessment claiming the US has fired over 200 THAAD interceptors, roughly half its inventory, plus over 100 SM-3 and SM-6 missiles defending Israel.

threads.label: Raisi anniversary messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a message marking the second anniversary of Shahid Raisi's martyrdom, alongside a tree-diagram graphic and a sapling-planting initiative in Azadegan Park by student Islamic associations. Defa Press circulated a video framed around Raisi's priority of power generation and defensive capabilities.

events.title_en: Self-infliction and chaos in European skies
events.summary_en: Self-infliction and chaos in European skies. In an unprecedented incident, an F-16 fighter of the Romanian Air Force, which is stationed as part of a NATO mission in the Baltic region, shot down a Ukrainian drone over Estonian territory. This is the first time since the start of NATO's Baltic Air Policing mission that a coalition fighter has destroyed an aerial target. Over recent weeks, several Ukrainian attack drones have deviated from their course due to electronic interference and Russian cyber warfare and entered the airspace of Baltic region countries. Some of these drones have even damaged energy infrastructure in Latvia, intensifying political tensions in that country.
